Hydrogen and ammonia: UK Energy Group and UK Nuclear 2026 MoU has no capacity figure; other items are 2023 or older. Not added.

checks.claim: UIUC and Nano Nuclear submitted a construction permit application to the NRC for a Kronos micro modular reactor on 2 April 2026
checks.evidence: World Nuclear News reports that the construction permit application was submitted on 31 March 2026 by the Grainger College of Engineering, with NANO Nuclear as partner. The 2 April 2026 date is the date of the trade-press report, not the filing date.
checks.correction: UIUC and Nano Nuclear submitted a construction permit application to the NRC for a Kronos micro modular reactor on 31 March 2026

applications.name: NGL Energy Partners and Natura Resources: produced-water desalination with a molten salt reactor
applications.power_class: 100 MW molten salt reactor (electric or thermal basis not stated)
applications.timeline: agreement announced 4 February 2026; no deployment date given
applications.what_it_says: Natura Resources and NGL Energy Partners agreed to look at pairing Natura's 100 MW molten salt reactor with NGL's produced-water treatment and desalination. The source says the two will collaborate in seeking opportunities and does not say the agreement is binding or give a site. Natura's produced-water work began in 2025 with Texas Tech and Abilene Christian University, which aims to treat produced water from oil and gas operations for beneficial use.
applications.microreactor_read: A 100 MW reactor is about five times the top of the 1-20 MW band, so it would take several blocks. The page gives no electric or thermal basis, no water volume, no power price and no site, so fit and price cannot be checked.
